headlines.summary: 재경부·국세청·산업인력공단·민간 전문가 참여 즉시 시행 가능한 대책 마련해 16일 오후 발표 국가자격시험 공통 대책·세무사 시험 별도 대책 추진 이형일 부총리 고발엔 "경찰 요청 시 필요한 협조" [서울=뉴시스]의혹을 부인하던 세무사 시험 수석 합격자를 설득해 수사 기관 자수와 공식 사과라는 정면 돌파를 이끈 법률대리인의 행보가 주목받고 있다.

headlines.summary: 첨단기기 부정행위 취약한 현장감독 세무사 1·2차 수석자백으로 드러나 정부, 국가시험 전수조사 나섰지만 부정행위 제재·기관 간 공조 한계 16일 오전 서울의 한 매장에 소형카메라가 진열돼 있다.  윤창빈 기자 올해 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 생성형 인공지능(AI)을 이용해 부정행위를 한 사실이 드러나면서 국가자격시험의 허술한 관리체계가 도마 위에 올랐다.

headlines.title: 한성숙 총리 " 수능 범정부 긴급 대응팀 구성…사후 점검체계도 강화"

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Purchase Psychology Falls for Third Consecutive Month While National Jeonse Market Hits Year High
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's housing transaction sentiment declined for the third consecutive month to the lowest level in six months, while national jeonse (lease) market sentiment reached its highest point this year with consecutive gains for three months.

key_headlines.title: Households Owning Over 1.2 Billion Won Properties Increase at Record Pace, Wealth Gap Peaks at 52 Times
key_headlines.summary: Households with properties valued over 1.2 billion won increased by a record 150,000 units in 2025, while the wealth gap between top and bottom 10% reached a maximum of 52 times.

key_headlines.title: Japan Q3 Economic Growth Rate -0.02%, Recording Negative Growth for First Time in Four Quarters
key_headlines.summary: Japan's real GDP for Q3 declined 0.02% quarter-on-quarter (annualized rate of -0.1%), driven by weak consumer spending and reduced net exports, marking the first negative growth in four quarters.

key_headlines.title: Government Establishes Task Force to Address AI Cheating in Tax Accountant Exam
key_headlines.summary: The government formed a task force involving the Ministry of Strategy and Finance, National Tax Service, and industry experts to address AI-related cheating in the tax accountant exam and prevent recurrence.

sections.Hot Economy News: Seoul's housing market shows weakening momentum with purchase sentiment declining for the third consecutive month, reaching the lowest level in six months. However, the national jeonse (lease) market sentiment surged to an all-time high this year amid three consecutive months of growth, indicating a shift from buying to renting behavior. The decline in Seoul prices has spread beyond Gangnam districts to Seongdong and Gangdong districts, with increased inventory as more sellers list properties. This divergence between sales and lease markets reflects household concerns about future price movements and changing investment strategies.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Japan's economy contracted in the third quarter with real GDP declining 0.02% quarter-on-quarter (annualized rate of -0.1%), marking the first negative growth in four quarters. The contraction was primarily driven by weak consumer spending, which fell 0.3% in the quarter, and declining net exports amid rising crude oil import burdens and yen depreciation. Market expectations had anticipated 0.2% growth, making the actual performance significantly worse than forecasts. This economic slowdown raises concerns about global growth momentum as one of the world's largest economies enters contraction territory.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic stock markets (KOSPI and KOSDAQ) declined 2-3% following an initial positive opening, pressured by concerns about US interest rates and artificial intelligence investments. Foreign investors accelerated selling, contributing to the broader market decline, with semiconductor and related component stocks experiencing sharper losses. The strong US 10-year Treasury yield surpassing 5.15% has increased macroeconomic uncertainty, while KOSPI ELS products maturing near the 9,000 level face potential losses amid the recent market selloff.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor and advanced manufacturing sectors remain focal points with reports of battery-related incidents in electric vehicles and smartphones raising safety concerns. Doosan Anatech, a semiconductor fabless company, is expanding its motor control and actuator technology from smartphones to automotive and robotics applications to capitalize on the growing physical AI market. OCI is highlighting silicon's dual roles from traditional ceramics to advanced semiconductors, while companies like Goyeong are gaining investor interest due to synergies between AI semiconductor inspection equipment and medical robotics.
sections.Real Estate: Incheon, the only metropolitan area experiencing apartment price declines, paradoxically shows rising jeonse (lease) prices due to shifted renter preferences and reduced rental inventory. The long-standing jeonse shortage continues as households reduce home-buying expectations and prefer to remain renters. GS Construction opened a model house for 'Ar Musje Zi' development in Ansan, featuring 1,354 units on the former Homeplus site, while high-rise apartments increasingly burden owners with significantly higher maintenance reserves, with some ultra-high-rise buildings requiring 20 times the reserve contributions of standard apartments.
sections.International Economy: US Treasury Secretary Bessent expressed cautious views on interest rate hikes, suggesting future decisions should reflect declining oil prices and economic conditions. Global automakers are increasing cooperation with China for cost advantages and technology transfer, creating a double-edged sword as they face potential sanctions in US and European markets regarding supply chain rules. The US Federal Reserve has identified AI-driven debt growth as a financial system risk, while the upcoming FOMC meeting this week is expected to provide guidance on December rate decisions and insights into policy deliberations.
sections.AI & Economy: Global AI infrastructure competition is driving demand for power infrastructure-related stocks, with Anthropic signing a $3.4 billion contract for 1.7GW capacity of Caterpillar gas generators for AI data centers. Daehan Optical Communications reported consecutive quarters of operating profitability driven by expanded AI data center supplies to North America, achieving 39.3% revenue growth. LG U+ is entering the corporate AI market with technology that reduces AI token costs by up to 90%, while concerns mount over China's economic slowdown despite stimulus measures, with AI-driven electronics exports currently sustaining growth but facing risks if export momentum weakens.
sections.Others: The government is advancing plans to introduce radio detection equipment in major national exams starting next year to combat AI-related cheating following a tax accountant exam incident. Nvidia's dominant position in semiconductor chips faces challenges as customers accelerate internal chip development and seek alternative suppliers to reduce single-vendor dependency. Discussions about raising cigarette taxes, frozen for 11 years, continue amid competing fiscal priorities for firefighting and public housing needs. The tax accountant exam cheating scandal highlighted successful government intervention through appointing legal representatives to convince the top passer to voluntarily confess and issue public apologies.
